name: 1inch Fusion v1 Settlement calldata corruption (resolver drain)
summary: Settlement._settleOrder() used attacker-controlled interactionLength in unchecked Yul pointer arithmetic. A wrapped length moved the appended suffix backward in memory, overwrote the authenticated resolver field, and made the deprecated Fusion v1 contract call a third-party resolver against its standing token approvals.
notes: The vulnerable unchecked Yul calldata-copy path is part of the contract's immutable direct runtime, deployed in this transaction and unchanged through the exploit.

The reported approximately $4.5 million is the gross TrustedVolumes drain. The selected transaction contains two exact 1,000,000 USDC transfers from the resolver, recorded here as a $2 million partial component. Decurity reports that nearly all funds were later returned and the attacker retained a negotiated bounty; recovery is not netted from exploit-time loss.
The $4.5 million gross loss is a rounded reported resolver-level total; only the selected transaction's exact two-million-USDC component is structured here.
